claim: The one-click sample uses separate storage, resets, and does not change the normal ledger.
where: home sample action, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: clean browser; create a normal job, change and reset the demo, leave demo, and verify the normal job is unchanged

claim: Records the client, scope, deposit, date, currency, and tax assumption.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger; inspect the populated display and stored sample record

claim: Prevents allocations above the deposit balance.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger; reject one cent over the balance and accept the exact balance

claim: Keeps dated held, earned, and returned history.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger; make two status changes, reload, and inspect the stored event sequence

claim: Exports a client-readable CSV allocation trail.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger; download CSV and assert job, allocation, tax assumption, and limitation content

claim: Exports a client-readable PDF allocation trail.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger; download PDF and decode its job, client, allocation, tax, and limitation text

claim: Exports and restores the complete ledger as JSON.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger; download backup, delete the sample, restore it, and verify allocations and status history

claim: Keeps job and client records in the browser unless the operator exports them.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger; save a change, inspect the demo IndexedDB database, and record all requests

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
where: home facts, privacy page, terms, README
sandbox: own fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker, remove the network, reload, and verify the populated ledger

claim: Keeps newer allocation history when a stale tab saves job details.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger in two tabs; change status in one, save stale notes in the other, and verify both survive

claim: Includes three jobs and data exports without a license.
where: home facts, paid section, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger without license; create up to three jobs, export, then verify the fourth opens purchase options

claim: Checks a stored license no more than once per day and keeps an invalid-license notice visible.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger with an expired cached verdict and recorded verification fixture; reload and assert one request plus persistent notice

claim: Uses no analytics, advertising cookies, third-party fonts, tracking scripts, or third-party requests during ledger work.
where: home privacy section, footer, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger; perform a status change and export while recording requests, cookies, scripts, and styles

claim: When checkout is available, $29 paid once removes the three-job limit through Sociobot checkout.
sandbox: fresh /demo ledger with recorded enabled-status and hosted-checkout fixtures; assert price, paid feature, and checkout destination
